description: Search the touring caravans, trailer tents and trailers of every kind: box, car transporter, horse, livestock, motorbike, boat, plant, tipper, flatbed, catering and utility for sale on Trailersite now, advertised by their UK owners. Filters: section, make, model, place, price, year, axles, brakes, coupling, gross and unladen weight, bed size, spare wheel, horses carried, berths and caravan layout. Returns up to 10 adverts, newest first, each with its price, place and advert link. Use get_listing_detail with an advert's slug and listingId for the full advert.

braked.description: true for braked trailers, false for unbraked.

category.description: Section: Touring caravans, Car transporters, Box trailers, Horse trailers, Motorbike trailers, Utility and camping trailers, Tipper trailers, Catering trailers, Boat and jet ski trailers, Livestock trailers, Plant trailers, Flatbed trailers, Trailer tents.

city.description: Town or city the advert is in.

coupling.description: ball_50mm is a standard tow ball; eye is a ring hitch.

horses.description: Horse trailers carrying at least this many; 3 is three or more.

limit.description: How many adverts to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

make.description: Maker, as the seller gave it.

maxGrossWeightKg.description: Highest gross (maximum laden) weight in kg.

minBerths.description: Fewest berths, for caravans and trailer tents.

minGrossWeightKg.description: Lowest gross (maximum laden) weight in kg.

model.description: Model, as the seller gave it.

q.description: Words to find in the advert title, make or model.

spareWheel.description: Only trailers sold with a spare wheel.
